name: Essential
alt: Three broad vermilion and orange folded planes with dark return faces, arranged in an upright zigzag.
description: Three broad folds preserve the original upright gesture. Smaller facets give way to larger faces and clearer white seams.
assessment: Closest to the original Foldscape, with a lighter, simpler structure.

name: Compact
alt: A compact group of red and orange angular planes with dark return faces and a diagonal white cleft.
description: The folded planes gather around one diagonal white cleft. Shorter projections and broader faces create a firmer center.
assessment: My strongest PFP candidate: the planes hold together as one compact shape.

name: Open
alt: Two folded planes, one orange and one vermilion, with dark return faces and an open diagonal gap.
description: Two folds answer each other across an open gap. Four broad colored faces carry the movement with very little internal detail.
assessment: The most minimal option. The gap and relative scale of the folds are the key refinement choices.
